print_config: print the whole mmdet config file by path and display its resolved pretty text
save_config: save the resolved mmdet config to a .py, .json, or .yml file at a specified path
override_config: override config settings using key=value pairs passed via --cfg-options argument
resolve_config_placeholders: replace ${key} placeholders in the config with their actual resolved values
update_data_root: update data root paths in the config according to MMDET_DATASETS environment variable
